annotations.title: EPLI — Wage & Hour Defense Sublimit
annotations.content:
[Bad] EPLI — Wage & Hour Defense Sublimit
Risk Score: 9/25

What this means:
If a former employee filed a wage and hour class action — a very common claim type — your insurance pays for $100K of defense costs and zero damages. The company manages its own defense (the carrier won't even appoint a lawyer). $100K is what one lawyer at a firm bills in three months on a class act

Recommendation:
Increase W&H defense sublimit to $250K-$500K at renewal. Audit timekeeping, exempt classifications, meal/rest break compliance especially in CA. Consider standalone wage & hour policy if exposure warr

annotations.title: D&O Entity Coverage — Manufacturing & Professional Services
annotations.content:
[Ugly] D&O Entity Coverage — Manufacturing & Professional Services 
Risk Score: 20/25

What this means:
Your D&O policy says: if a county sues your company because a ballot system failed or you didn't deliver election services correctly, the company itself is NOT covered. annotations.title: PE Co-Defendant Extension on Management Liability
annotations.content:
[Good] PE Co-Defendant Extension on Management Liability

What this means:
Your PE owners (Lincoln Shields and Black Mountain) are protected by your D&O if someone sues them solely because they own you. Good. They probably also have their own insurance, but yours is a useful first line.

Recommendation:
Maintain. Verify named entities still match current ownership at each renewal.
